# Setup Rust

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Install a Rust toolchain with components and a warm cargo cache

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/setup-rust@v1
```

## How it works

Rust toolchain setup with a shared cargo cache.

Uses actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain, which reads `rust-toolchain.toml` when
present and wires up the (substantial) cargo registry + target-dir cache. Rust CI without
that cache is dominated by rebuild time, so caching is on by default.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `toolchain` | no | `stable` | Toolchain spec: `stable`, `nightly`, `1.83.0`, or empty to read rust-toolchain.toml. |
| `components` | no | `clippy,rustfmt` | Comma-separated components, e.g. `clippy,rustfmt`. |
| `targets` | no | `""` | Comma-separated cross-compilation targets. |
| `cache` | no | `true` | true to enable the cargo cache. |
| `cache-key` | no | `""` | Extra discriminator appended to the cache key. |
| `working-directory` | no | `.` | Directory containing Cargo.toml. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `rustc-version` | The rustc version string. |
